title: Join Us for Investor Day Los Angeles
summary: Join us for FPA Investor Day Los Angeles, taking place in Santa Monica, California on Wednesday, October 21, and Thursday, October 22, 2026.
body_markdown:
Join us for FPA Investor Day Los Angeles, taking place in Santa Monica, California on Wednesday, October 21, and Thursday, October 22, 2026.


This two-day event is designed to offer a comprehensive view of our investment philosophy, current market perspectives, and how we are positioning portfolios for the long term.


- The event will begin on Wednesday, October 21, with a welcome reception at Pacific Terrace at Shutters on the Beach, providing time to connect with fellow clients and the FPA team.


- Thursday, October 22, will feature investment team presentations at Casa Del Mar, along with interactive Q&A sessions. The day will conclude with a cocktail hour followed by dinner. Breakfast and lunch will be provided during the program.


Please complete the registration form below by **Wednesday, October 7,** to submit your RSVP for this event.

**5:30pm – 7:00pm:** Cocktail Hour / Welcome Reception

**3:30pm – 5:00pm:**
Break Before Cocktails and Dinner


**Evening Program – Thursday, October 22nd**
*Colonnade Terrace (Patio), Casa Del Mar*


**5:00pm – 5:30pm:**
Cocktails


**5:30pm – 8:00pm:**
**Dinner, Remarks & Audience Q&A with Valter Longo, Ph.D.**


**Prof. Valter Longo** is an internationally recognized expert in nutrition, longevity, and age-related diseases. He is Professor of Biogerontology and Director of the Longevity Institute at USC, with over 30 years of research in nutrition, genetics, and aging. He developed the fasting mimicking diet and the Longevity Diet, and his book *The Longevity Diet* has become an international bestseller. In 2018, *TIME* named him among the 50 most influential people in health, and he has been recognized as a Clarivate Highly Cited Researcher from 2021 to 2025.
